decisive_items: Endomyocardial biopsies revealed a malignant spindle cell tumor, histology consistent with the monophasic variant
Cytogenetics by fluorescence in situ hybridization showed SS18 (SYT;18q11.2) translocation
Trans-thoracic echocardiography (TTE) showed a large left ventricular (LV) mass
response.rationale: The LV mass with malignant spindle cell histology and SS18 translocation is diagnostic of cardiac synovial sarcoma; renal infarction is a downstream embolic complication, not the primary diagnosis.

rejected.why: Renal infarction is a secondary finding from embolization of the cardiac tumor, not the underlying disease.
